title: EXTRACTION MOMENTS IN THE ALERT LANE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD. Calling for extraction said one line of about 130 characters (Pulled, the wait, how to extract, THE SIEGE and its size, and a sentence about the backpack), so most of it ran off the plate or was pushed down. It is now EXTRACTION CALLED with the wait and the key that extracts under it, then THE SIEGE with how many machines are coming, then a short backpack row (HEAVY BACKPACK, They heard that). The window opening reads his phrase EXTRACT IN PROGRESS! with Hold [E] to extract. A missed window reads EXTRACTION LEFT WITHOUT YOU in amber, closing rings read EXTRACTION B CLOSING and EXTRACTION B CLOSED in amber, a teammate calling reads EXTRACTION CALLED with his name and the ring, and his knocked down line keeps his words as an extraction alert. The band under the clock still owns every countdown, and the siege maths are untouched.
now: Calling for extraction shows EXTRACTION CALLED, then THE SIEGE with its size, then a short backpack row, instead of one 130 character line.
